ResearchProjectDef.label: Motion sensor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build an automated switch that closes the circuit while any living creature is within its detection radius (1-5 tiles).

ResearchProjectDef.label: Power crossing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a conduit crossing. The north-south line and the west-east line pass through the same cell without connecting to each other. Attached devices connect to the north-south line.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Signal timer
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a delay relay. Input is the south side, output is the north side. The output adopts the input signal only after it has stayed unchanged for the set time (1-30 seconds); if the signal flips back during the countdown, the timer resets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Time sensor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build an automated switch that toggles based on the time of day.
